name: Pacific Medical Prosthetics & Orthotics
old_description: Delivering Better Orthopedic Outcomes—One Patient, One Provider at a Time.
about:
Pacific Medical, Inc. was founded in 1987 by John Petlansky and is headquartered in Tracy, California. The company began as a durable medical equipment distributor serving eight western states and has since expanded its footprint across 18 states.

The company operates 15 orthotic and prosthetic patient care facilities and 40 satellite offices, supported by more than 200 internal staff and an external sales and service force of over 215 professionals. Its divisions include OrthoLIFE, a proprietary patient-centered orthopedic rehabilitation platform; a Surgical Division providing innovative solutions for orthopedic and surgical care; a Biologics Division delivering advanced regenerative products; and Top Shelf Orthopedics supporting product design, management, and distribution.

Pacific Medical serves healthcare providers and patients in the orthopedic rehabilitation, arthroscopic surgery, sports medicine, prosthetics, and orthotics markets. The company reports serving 540,000 lives annually through its network of hospitals and clinics across the western United States.

The company emphasizes innovation with integrity and partnerships with purpose, positioning its OrthoLIFE platform as a tailored DME solution that streamlines care and improves outcomes. Its biologics division focuses on regenerative products that promote healing, while its dedicated team of over 400 professionals acts as a extension of partner practices.

name: Pajaro Valley Fabrication Inc.
old_description: At Pajaro Valley Fabrication, we understand the unique challenges in fabricating one-off or large-scale production items alike.
about:
Pajaro Valley Fabrication Inc. operates from a 10,000-square-foot facility in Watsonville, California. The company was founded in 2006 and is privately held; ownership details are not publicly disclosed. It began as a custom metal fabrication shop serving local agricultural and industrial needs.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication, welding (MIG, Stick, Flux Core, TIG), waterjet cutting via a Flow Mach 2 machine with a 10-by-6-foot bed, bending and shearing using two Amada hydraulic shears and two hydraulic presses, rolling, machining (drilling, lathe, hole punching), design, assembly, and material sales with cutting, cleaning, and punching services. Four-plus full-time fabricators handle one-off prototypes through large production runs.

Agriculture accounts for roughly 65 percent of the business, with the company supplying prototype components, maintenance parts, and structural repairs for farm equipment, including hydraulic system work. Commercial and residential clients receive products such as custom ventilation tubes, truck beds with power lifts, trailers, lumber racks, sandblasting tubes, barbecue tables, fire pits, gates, and stainless countertops.

The company emphasizes its certified welders with over 20 years of experience and a team that combines technical expertise with industry knowledge to deliver turnaround on both one-off and high-volume jobs. It states that it builds industrial-grade products even for non-industrial applications.

name: Pallas Textiles
old_description: Inspired by Claude Monet and the gardens of Giverny, our newest collection translates fleeting light, softened color, and painterly
about:
Pallas Textiles operates from Green Bay, Wisconsin. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials.

The company produces upholsteries, panel fabrics, and privacy curtains by fusing traditional weaving with modern fiber techniques. Collections such as Giverny — inspired by Claude Monet’s gardens — translate painterly gestures into textured textiles. Pallas manages a sample program offering color and pattern swatches, and maintains a network of sales representatives across the United States and internationally.

Its textiles serve healthcare environments, commercial interiors, and contract furniture manufacturers; the company notes KI products approved for its Monet pattern. Pallas exhibits at events such as the Healthcare Design Expo and hosts design workshops where clients create bags, pillows, and other items using its fabrics.

Pallas describes its approach as “Made True,” emphasizing genuine materials and authentic people. It positions its point of difference as the marriage of artisanal weaving heritage with contemporary fiber technology to deliver curated colors, nature‑inspired patterns, and performance suited to healing spaces.

name: Palmetto Sheet Metal

about:
Palmetto Sheet Metal operates from Dalzell, South Carolina, as a locally owned and operated fabrication shop. The company specializes in sheet metal products for roofing, metal buildings, and custom projects, combining traditional workmanship with modern CNC equipment to deliver precision-crafted metal solutions.

The shop produces roofing and metal building trim, accessories, commemorative plaques, displays, and custom one-off pieces using CNC precision cutting and forming. It handles both large-scale production runs and small custom jobs, serving residential, commercial, and industrial clients with a focus on accuracy and efficiency.

Customers span food service, HVAC, construction, and DIY markets, with contractors, builders, and homeowners among the typical buyers. The company also fabricates custom components for commemorative and personal projects, extending its reach beyond traditional construction applications.

Palmetto Sheet Metal emphasizes reliable quality, fair pricing, and fast turnaround, backed by a responsive team and broad material selection. Its mission centers on delivering precision-crafted metal solutions with honest service and a commitment to customer success.

about:
Panic Plastics, Inc. is based in Payette, Idaho, where it has operated for over 35 years. The company was founded to provide thermoformed plastic packaging solutions, though the exact founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs, develops, and manufactures custom thermoformed plastic packaging, including clamshells, blister packs, and thermoformed trays. It also offers stock packaging programs that eliminate mold costs and allow next-day shipping with minimum orders as low as a single case. In addition to packaging, Panic Plastics supplies printed insert cards, blister and clamshell sealing equipment, and provides in-house design and tooling services.

Its customers span a wide and diverse range of industries, though specific sectors are not listed. The company emphasizes working closely with clients from design through delivery to meet demanding schedules.

Panic Plastics states its mission is to manufacture the finest quality thermoformed packaging while delivering competitively priced products on time. Its stated values include respect for co-workers, ethical conduct, continuous improvement, and treating customers right. The company positions itself as a dedicated thermoforming division accessible by phone, highlighting fast-track delivery as a key service.

name: Papé Machinery Agriculture & Turf
old_description: Find reliable agriculture & turf equipment tailored to your budget.
about:
Based in Bend, Oregon, Papé Machinery Agriculture & Turf operates as an authorized John Deere dealer with a network of more than 35 full-service locations across Oregon, Washington, California, Nevada, and Idaho.

The dealership sells new and used agriculture equipment — including combines, sprayers, tillers, cultivators, and a range of John Deere tractors such as the 1025R, 2025R, 3025E, and 4044M compact utility models — along with implements and attachments. For commercial turf customers, it stocks zero-turn and walk-behind mowers, while residential buyers can choose from John Deere, Stihl, and Honda chainsaws, trimmers, blowers, generators, and lawn tractors. The company also offers John Deere Gator utility vehicles in mid- and full-size configurations. Parts are sold through the Shop.Deere platform with illustrated diagrams and maintenance kits, and each location provides service bays for scheduled maintenance and repairs.

Customers include row-crop and specialty farmers, commercial landscaping crews, municipal parks departments, and homeowners. A highlighted case study features Smith Bros. Farms, a multi-generation grass-seed operation in the Willamette Valley that relies on Papé Machinery for equipment and support.

Papé Machinery emphasizes local availability and uptime, stating that its knowledgeable team members across the six-state footprint are positioned to maximize customer uptime. Orders placed through Shop.Deere are backed by the dealership’s local parts expertise and service network.

name: Paradise Energy Solutions
old_description: Means that the equipment for your new solar array is 100% exempt from MD sales and use taxes
about:
Paradise Energy Solutions operates from two Maryland branch offices in Hagerstown and Salisbury, where it serves as a family-owned, full-service solar energy company. The business lists Jason Beiler as a solar consultant and owner among a staff that includes project managers, foremen, electricians, and dedicated service technicians.

The company designs and installs custom solar arrays for commercial, agricultural, and residential customers. Its service division, branded Paradise Protect, provides annual performance analysis with recommendations, routine system checkups, and ongoing maintenance. The team handles the full project lifecycle from consultation and engineering through permitting, installation, and incentive paperwork.

Customers span Maryland businesses, farms, and homeowners seeking to offset electricity costs. The firm assists with Solar Renewable Energy Certificates (SRECs), the 30 percent federal investment tax credit for commercial projects, USDA loans and grants for qualifying agricultural installations, and the state sales-and-use tax exemption on solar equipment.

Founded on a family-ownership model, Paradise Energy emphasizes a single-point-of-contact approach that combines design, installation, and long-term service under one roof. The company states its goal is to help people save money with solar energy while delivering reliable, locally supported systems.
